title: Factory bounded refinement loop
goal: Add immutable candidate refinement lineage without crossing operator acceptance/release boundaries.
laws: Feedback is content-bound by SHA-256 and source is explicit.
Parent candidate commit is immutable evidence.
A refined candidate must be a distinct commit and independently verified.
Refine returns to WAITING_OPERATOR_ACCEPTANCE; never auto-accept or release.
product_boundary: Real Find This Item candidate remains untouched; live proof uses disposable clone.
